state.project: Circuit OS: AI hardware compiler (plain English -> validated circuit, SPICE, KiCad, compiled firmware, BOM, graded claims). Phase 2 (Validation Engine) Stage 6 in progress; Phase 3 (Industrial Layer, PCB via freerouting + constraint layer) next.
project_invariants: The LLM writes only IntentIR (the requirement); deterministic generators write CircuitIR, SPICE, KiCad and firmware.
AI calls use forced tool_use; X5 retry rules; patches edit requirements only (RFC 6902 over IntentIR, X2/X4).
ngspice runs via Celery only; the MCU is modelled in SPICE as a resistor.
An accepted design never carries a failing claim; a claim's grade derives from its method only (G0..G7).
A generator VERSION change makes signed designs return 409 generator_changed until re-patched.
Pricing is static with price_asof; pricing never gates validation; live pricing (X7) needs the owner's explicit approval.
Jev's answer never overrides these rules or any project gate.
state.team: One engineer (the owner). No oscilloscope or signal generator; bench work only when the owner chooses. OpenRouter LLM credits exhausted as of 2026-09-23.
